fields.title: Real Estate Market Analyst
fields.description: Analyze metro property market indices, supply-demand dynamics, and emerging micro-market investment corridors.
fields.responsibilities: ["Track quarterly price movements, absorption rates, and rental yields", "Publish comprehensive market intelligence reports and investment guides", "Support property advisory teams with data-backed investment models"]

fields.niceToHave: ["Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or spatial mapping tools"]

fields.title: Full Stack Developer
fields.description: Build and scale modern web applications, property discovery portals, and internal CRM tools for A to I Infra.
fields.responsibilities: ["Develop high-performance frontends using Next.js, React, and TypeScript", "Build resilient REST APIs and microservices using Node.js and Prisma", "Collaborate with product designers to create seamless user journeys"]
fields.requirements: ["Proficiency with TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL", "Strong understanding of web performance, SEO, and responsive design", "Experience deploying on cloud platforms (AWS, Vercel)"]
fields.niceToHave: ["Experience with real estate tech platforms or map APIs"]
fields.benefits: ["Hybrid Work Option", "Health & Wellness Insurance", "Tech Gadget Allowance"]

fields.responsibilities: ["Manage end-to-end recruitment cycle from sourcing to final offer rollout", "Build talent pipelines for luxury property advisors and technical roles", "Coordinate structured onboarding and employee engagement programs"]

fields.niceToHave: ["Familiarity with NCR real estate market regulations"]
fields.benefits: ["Comprehensive Health Insurance", "Annual Performance Bonus", "Rapid Career Progression"]

fields.title: Legal & Compliance Counsel
fields.description: Lead legal due diligence, title verification, RERA compliance, and buyer agreements for real estate portfolios.

fields.requirements: ["LLB or LLM degree with active Bar Council registration", "4+ years of practical experience in real estate and property law", "Deep understanding of title verification, conveyance, and registration"]
fields.niceToHave: ["Experience handling RERA authority filings and disputes"]
fields.benefits: ["Corporate Legal Insurance", "Bar Association Dues Paid", "Executive Bonus"]

fields.quote: A to I Infra made our property acquisition seamless. Their deep market analysis on Noida Expressway helped us secure a premium 4 BHK with 22% capital gain in 18 months.
Absolute luxury experience. The private site tours were extremely well organized. Their knowledge of premium micro-markets is unmatched.
Investing in Indian real estate from abroad was always daunting until we met the A to I Infra team. Zero brokerage, transparent documentation, and end-to-end tenant placement.
A to I Infra respects tech innovation. We are building products that redefine real estate search, utilizing cutting-edge Next.js architecture.
Highly professional team. They helped us select a pre-leased space with an MNC tenant, offering immediate rental yields of 7.5% per annum.
Working here has been transformative. The commission structure is highly rewarding, and leadership genuinely invests in your growth path.
Exceeded all expectations! The team mapped properties according to our budget and negotiated a fantastic rate. Truly professional service from start to finish.
Very transparent transaction. No hidden costs. They walked us through the RERA portals and legal paperwork patiently. Highly recommended for first-time buyers.
Excellent response time. We got the exact unit we wanted overlooking the central forest green. Great relationship with top developer teams.
What I love about A to I is the transparent culture. There is no bureaucracy — you have direct access to founders to pitch suggestions.
Elegant process. Their advisors are polite, experienced, and respect our privacy. Handled NRI documentation flawlessly via power of attorney.
Smooth legal documentation and verification checks. They saved us from investing in an unauthorized project. Valuable, trusted advice.
The energy in this company is contagious. The onboarding training was comprehensive, enabling me to close my first major commercial deal in 30 days.
Bought a plot near the Jewar Airport zone. Prices have already appreciated 25%. A to I Infra guided us to buy at the perfect time before the major surge.
Stunning property and stellar consultancy. Their structural insight and comparison matrices helped us pick Experion over Gurugram projects.
We don't just sell; we consult. The focus on customer satisfaction changes the whole dynamic. It makes you proud of where you work.
The balance between client service and training is fantastic. We are regularly updated on RERA compliance policies by our legal team.
A highly reliable consultancy. They assisted with my home loan from SBI at an excellent interest rate. The post-purchase customer success team is outstanding.
A to I Infra has the best portfolio of commercial properties. The rental returns on our pre-leased property have been consistent and exactly as projected.
Strong commercial foresight. The location they suggested is receiving heavy commercial footfall now. Very happy with the long-term appreciation.
